quotes.text: Did you do any paid work in the 7 days ending Sunday the [date], either as an employee or as self-employed?
Did you do any unpaid work in that week (ending Sunday the [date] for any business that you own?
...or (any unpaid work for a business) that a relative owns?
May I just check, what was the main reason you did not look for work (in the last 4 weeks)

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire defines work across questions WRKING, OWNBUS, and RELBUS strictly as paid work (as an employee or self-employed) or unpaid work for a business owned by the respondent or a relative. Unpaid domestic and care work is not included within this activity category. Instead, domestic and family care duties are treated as a separate category, specifically as a reason for not seeking work (NOLWM code 3: 'Looking after the family/home').
